added_in_this_package: execution-lifecycle emitters: record_order_intent, record_risk_decision, record_broker_ack, record_fill, record_exit_decision, record_realized_outcome
make_decision_audit_handler() mapping OrderManager audit events -> decision events, attributed by correlation_id -> decision_id

integrity_properties_verified.nonblocking: emit is O(1) and never raises (double try/except).
integrity_properties_verified.bounded_overflow: deque(maxlen); oldest evicted; dropped counter accurate (capacity=3, 10 emits -> size 3, dropped 7, newest retained).
integrity_properties_verified.persistence_failure_resilience: journal.append raising on every call never blocks emission; event still buffered.
integrity_properties_verified.missing_event_recovery: rows persisted to the authoritative journal can be rehydrated into a fresh sink; unknown event types skipped, not fabricated.
integrity_properties_verified.traceability: recommendation decision_id + correlation_id link ORDER_INTENT -> RISK_APPROVAL/REJECTION -> BROKER_ACK -> PARTIAL_FILL/COMPLETE_FILL -> REALIZED_OUTCOME.

financially_critical_recoverability: Order lifecycle is independently captured by the authoritative audit journal (OrderManager on_audit) regardless of the bounded decision-event buffer, so financial events remain recoverable even after decision-buffer overflow.
verdict: DECISION-EVENT EVIDENCE COMPLETE AND RECOVERABLE. Foundation ready for the later Parquet/DuckDB ML/RL platform (not built here).
